description:
Check whether a page's og:video plays when its link is shared. Reads every og:video declaration and its structured properties (secure_url, type, width, height) the way ogp.me defines them, then fetches the first 512 KB of the video and identifies the real format from the file header, along with byte-range support, MP4 fast start, pixel size and length. Also fetches og:image as the poster and reports the tags the other readers use instead: the X player card (twitter:card player, twitter:player) and a Google VideoObject in JSON-LD. Pass the page URL, not the video file. Use check_social_preview for how the title, description and image render per platform.

Returns { hasPlayableVideo, primary, videos[] with declared tags and probe (format, kind, dimensions, durationSeconds, rangeSupported, fastStart, problem), image, ogType, videoMeta, twitter, videoObject, checks[] with id, status and fix, counts }. Limit: 60 runs per hour per IP. Allow up to 30s for a response. Free, no account, no API key.

refresh.description: Skip the 24 hour cache and run again. Costs a rate-limit slot even when a cached result exists, so leave it off unless the page has changed.

url.description: The page to run against. A bare domain like example.com is fine; https is assumed. Must be a public URL: anything behind a login, on a private network, or on localhost is refused.

name: check_og_video
title: Open Graph Video Checker
